declared: 2026-11-08, before the frozen rustc 1.98.0 oracle of these exact bytes and before any candidate run of these bytes. The shapes reduce census 9's crate record (core's `Option::as_deref`, `pub const fn as_deref(&self) -> Option<&T::Target> where T: [const] Deref`, option.rs:1386). Census batch 8 (section 2) records that its drafts of the named-lifetime, argument, method, static, raw-pointer, plain-bound and direct-ref shapes (obj/parallel/census-batch8/repro) were run through the compiler and that rustc 1.98.0 accepts the named-lifetime reduction, so `named-lifetime`, `argument`, `as-deref`, `static-ref`, `raw-pointer`, `plain-bound` and `direct-ref` are a regression record of that exploration; the other cases were not run by anyone. Each outcome follows the stated rule (a `[const]` or `const` trait bound implies the ordinary trait bound, as rustc 1.98 elaborates it, so the projection it names is well formed and its rigid result keeps the caller's reference lifetimes; an unsized projection is still not a sized argument and a projection without any bound on its subject is still unproven)

amendments.amended: 2026-11-08, after the first frozen rustc 1.98.0 oracle and before any candidate run of either the original or the amended bytes
amendments.corrected: this reason first said eleven controls; it was recounted after the amended oracle ran (outcomes and declaration_sha256 unchanged)
amendments.reason: rustc 1.98.0 reported `requires freeze lang_item` for twelve controls, rejecting ten declared to be accepted: const checking of a const fn that yields an ADT value queries `Freeze`, which the no_core prefix lacked. Every file gains `auto_traits` in its feature list and `#[lang = "freeze"] pub unsafe auto trait Freeze {}` (the PA28 source-transmute declaration) after `Copy`. No signature, body or declared outcome changes.

as-deref.rs.reason: core's exact `Option::as_deref` method shape (option.rs:1386): `Option<&T::Target>` under `T: [const] Deref` with an elided reference lifetime

named-lifetime.rs.reason: the free-function reduction with a named lifetime: `Option<&'a T::Target>` under `T: [const] Deref`

argument.rs.reason: the same `Option<&T::Target>` as a parameter type

as-deref-mut.rs.reason: core's `Option::as_deref_mut` shape: `Option<&mut T::Target>` under `T: [const] DerefMut`, whose supertrait is `[const] Deref`

slice-index.rs.reason: core's `<[T]>::get` shape as a free function: `Option<&'a I::Output>` under `I: [const] SliceIndex<[T]>`, a const trait with a type parameter

always-const.rs.reason: the reduction under an always-const `T: const Deref` bound

plain-bound.rs.reason: guard: `Option<&'a T::Target>` under a plain `T: Deref` bound

direct-ref.rs.reason: guard: `&T::Target` without a nominal wrapper under `T: [const] Deref`

unsized-target.rs.reason: opponent: `Option<T::Target>` under `T: [const] Deref` needs `T::Target: Sized`, which a `?Sized` target lacks (E0277)

missing-bound.rs.reason: opponent: `Option<&'a <T as Deref>::Target>` with no bound on `T` leaves `T: Deref` unproven (E0277)
